title: Solving and Learning Navier-Stokes Dynamics with the Neural Basis Method
abstract: arXiv:2610.32167v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physics-informed machine learning has become a major direction in predictive modeling of fluid dynamics, combining governing physics with learned representations. Yet prevailing formulations neither guarantee that small PDE-residual losses imply small solution errors nor scale effectively with increasing problem size. Here we present the neural basis method (NBM) as a new approach for Navier--Stokes dynamics. NBM is built on a ``representation-then-projection'' principle: fixed neural bases define the representation space, while projection of the governing equations determines the expansion coefficients. The same bases define common coordinates for the parametric solution manifold, recasting operator learning as a parameter-to-coefficient mapping and enabling scalability by removing explicit spatial dependence. translated_title: 基于神经基方法的纳维-斯托克斯动力学求解与学习
translated_abstract: 物理信息机器学习已成为流体动力学预测建模的一个重要方向，它将控制物理方程与学习到的表示相结合。然而，现有的主流方法既不能保证较小的PDE残差损失意味着较小的解误差，也无法随问题规模的增长而有效扩展。本文提出神经基方法（NBM）作为求解纳维-斯托克斯动力学的一种新方法。NBM建立在“先表示、后投影”的原则之上：固定的神经基函数定义表示空间，而通过投影控制方程来确定展开系数。同一组神经基为参数化解流形提供了公共坐标系，从而将算子学习重新表述为从参数到系数的映射，并通过消除显式空间依赖性实现了可扩展性。对于不可压缩流动，NBM给出了一种仅含速度变量的公式，其残差可作为后验速度误差估计。
tldr: 提出神经基方法（NBM），基于“先表示后投影”原则，将纳维-斯托克斯方程的求解与算子学习转化为固定神经基上的参数到系数映射，同时具备后验误差估计保证与良好的可扩展性。
en_tdlr: The neural basis method (NBM) solves and learns Navier-Stokes dynamics through a "representation-then-projection" principle, recasting operator learning as a parameter-to-coefficient mapping on fixed neural bases, providing both a posteriori error estimation and scalability.
